subject: Rework: demo format to accommodate VP/CTO travel windows
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@brightworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: Tuesday demo — confirm VP availability?

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the interest — excited to show the platform next week. We tentatively penciled the demo for Tuesday, Apr 6 at 10:00am PT. Before I lock the invite, can you confirm whether Marcus (VP Product) plans to join? If Marcus can make the first 25–30 minutes, we can prioritize the executive overview + ROI slides up front and then dive into the tech deep-dive for the rest of the time.

If Marcus or Alex (CTO) have constrained windows, we can either compress the session or split it into:
- Exec overview (30m): business outcomes, pricing approach, SLA/enterprise hooks
- Technical deep-dive (45m): architecture, integration, quantization/ops assumptions

Please let me know preferred option and any hard constraints so I can coordinate with our engineers.

Thanks,
Dylan
Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0123

Attachment: (none in this message)
From: Priya Shah <priya@brightworks.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Chen <marcus.chen@brightworks.com>, Alex Li <alex.li@brightworks.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: Tuesday demo — confirm VP availability?

Thanks Dylan — quick update from our side. Marcus wants to join and will be available for roughly the first 30 minutes of the slot, but he is flying in that morning so the timing is tight. Alex (CTO) may only be able to hop on at the end of the meeting (if at all) due to back-to-back customer calls.

Because Marcus is the primary sponsor for this deal, we want him to see the high-level value first. Given the travel, would you be open to either:
1) Compressing the demo to a 30/45 split (30m exec + 45m tech) back-to-back the same day, or
2) Splitting into two discrete meetings: an exec overview (30m) when Marcus is available, and a technical deep-dive later that day or later in the week when Alex and the engineering team can attend.

I've attached Marcus’s travel itinerary (flight ETA 09:30am PT) — if we do a back-to-back on Apr 6, he should be on time for a 10:30am start but we wanted to confirm with you on timeline and buffer.

Priya
Senior Customer Success Manager
BrightWorks
Attachment: travel-itinerary.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: Tuesday demo — confirm VP availability?

Great context — thanks Priya. Dylan / Karthik and I chatted and here's a proposal that gives Marcus the executive coverage he needs without losing the technical signal for Alex and the engineering team.

Proposed format for Apr 6 (same day, reduces meeting overhead):
- 10:30–11:00am PT — Executive overview (Marcus + any execs) 
  - Focus: outcomes, pricing/commit options, references, brief prod roadmap
  - Attendees: Marcus, Priya, Dylan, Marissa
- 11:05–12:00pm PT — Technical deep-dive (engineers + CTO)
  - Focus: deployment options (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), performance benchmarks, integration checklist, security/compliance (SOC2, audit logs)
  - Attendees: Alex (if available), Karthik, Dylan, BrightWorks eng leads

Why split vs compress: splitting preserves time for Marcus to get the executive narrative without the noise of architecture detail, and gives Alex/Karthik a clean window to go through ops and integration without time pressure. We can keep both invites linked in the calendar so it's obvious they are part of the same engagement.

I've attached the current demo deck (demo-deck-v3.pdf) — Dylan, feel free to swap slides for the exec session. If BrightWorks prefers same-day back-to-back instead of two separate invites, we can also do that and keep a 5-minute buffer between sessions.

If that works, I'll send calendar invites and include dial-in and a Google Meet link.

Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: demo-deck-v3.pdf

Hi Marissa / Dylan — that plan looks good. Marcus confirmed he can do 10:30–11:00am and will join in person; Alex will try to attend the 11:05 technical session but will confirm tomorrow. Please go ahead and send separate calendar invites (linked) for the exec and tech sessions.

Also can you include the rubric slide on cost-per-conversation and our integration checklist in the tech deck? That will help the engineering team triage next steps.

Thanks — attaching the calendar link once you send it would be helpful.

Priya
